title: Used To: Past Habits and States
explanation: Use used to + base verb for habits and states in the past that are not true now: I used to play football every weekend (but I don't now). The negative is didn't use to and the question is Did you use to …? Do not use used to for something that happened once.
explanationPersian: از used to + فعل ساده برای عادت‌ها و وضعیت‌های گذشته‌ای استفاده کن که الان درست نیستند: I used to play football every weekend (اما الان نمی‌کنم). منفی‌اش didn't use to و سؤالش Did you use to …؟ است. برای اتفاقی که فقط یک‌بار افتاده used to به کار نمی‌رود.

examples.english: I used to play football every weekend.
examples.persian: قبلاً هر آخر هفته فوتبال بازی می‌کردم.

examples.english: She used to live in Shiraz.
examples.persian: او قبلاً در شیراز زندگی می‌کرد.

examples.english: I didn't use to like coffee.
Did you use to walk to school?

exercises.prompt: I ___ play football every weekend, but now I don't have time.
Which sentence is about something that happened ONCE?
options: Last year I went to Canada.
I used to go to Canada.
I used to going to Canada.
exercises.explanation: used to is for repeated habits, not a single event.
exercises.explanationPersian: used to برای عادت تکراری است، نه یک رویداد.

exercises.after: to live in Shiraz, but now she lives in Tehran.

commonErrors.feedback: For the past it is 'used to' (with -d).
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: برای گذشته used to (با d) درست است.
بعد از Did می‌نویسیم use to.

exercises.explanation: In questions and negatives: use to (no -d).
exercises.explanationPersian: در سؤال و منفی: use to (بدون d).

exercises.incorrectSentence: I use to walk to school.
acceptedAnswers: I used to walk to school.
I didn't use to like coffee.
I did not use to like coffee.
I never used to like coffee.

commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از didn't بنویس use to (بدون d).

exercises.prompt: Now I live in Tehran. Before, I lived in Shiraz. Say the second sentence with "used to".
acceptedAnswers: I used to live in Shiraz.
